title: Off-duty Border Patrol agent charged with murder in fatal Texana Street stabbing
excerpt: The 30-year-old off-duty Border Patrol agent detained in the fatal Oct. 28 Texana Street stabbing has been charged with murder, the Laredo Morning Times reported, in the case police are calling Laredo's sixth homicide of 2026.
content:
The off-duty U.S. Border Patrol agent detained in the fatal early-morning stabbing on Texana Street has been charged with murder, according to the Laredo Morning Times, which reported the charge on October 28. KGNS also reported that a man has been charged with murder in the death of a Laredo woman.

This is a development in the case Webb Watch reported earlier on October 28, when Laredo Police Chief Miguel Rodriguez confirmed that the detained man is a Border Patrol agent. Police are calling the case Laredo's sixth homicide of 2026.

According to the earlier Times report, Laredo police responded to multiple calls about a domestic disturbance in the 5500 block of Texana Street at about 2:45 a.m. on Wednesday, October 28. A police drone pilot saw a vehicle leaving the area, and officers intercepted it. A 28-year-old woman was found alive in the rear floorboard of the vehicle with multiple stab wounds. She was taken to a hospital and later died.

The detained man is 30 years old, the earlier report said, and children reported inside the home were found unharmed after an emergency sweep. Police said the case was being investigated as domestic violence, but the circumstances were still unclear Wednesday morning.

The man charged is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law. Webb Watch will update this story when police or court records release the names of the people involved, the charging documents, or a bond amount.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, “Off-duty Border Patrol agent charged with murder after wife’s fatal stabbing in Laredo,” October 28, 2026
  • KGNS, “Man charged with murder in death of Laredo woman,” October 28, 2026
